scripts.build:zsc: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path zsc-wasm/Cargo.toml && node scripts/copy-wasm.mjs zsc
scripts.build:grammar: node scripts/copy-wasm.mjs mkdir && cd tree-sitter-zustscript && tree-sitter generate && tree-sitter build --wasm -o ../public/tree-sitter-zustscript.wasm && cd .. && node scripts/copy-wasm.mjs grammar
scripts.build:wasm: npm run build:zsc && npm run build:grammar
